comment: The French of Cartouche's App Intents (launcher/Sources/CartoucheShortcuts.swift), which Siri and the Shortcuts app show: app/scripts/app_intents.py writes strings into the app's fr.lproj/Localizable.strings, where iOS looks for the words of an app's intents, and phrases, Siri's, into its AppShortcuts.strings. Each key is the English as the intents give it, a phrase with its game as ${game} and Cartouche's name as ${applicationName}, which every phrase holds, as Siri needs it. The build stops when a title or a phrase of the intents has no French here (app/tests/test_app_intents.py checks it on Linux too).

strings.Opens Cartouche and starts one of your g: Ouvre Cartouche et lance un de vos jeux, comme Jouer.
